2. Feed those nodes through the existing `docs.api` prose translation path and reassemble the fence without changing markup, attributes, whitespace, comments, scripts, styles, or `<code>` content.
3. Add lossless round-trip and translation tests in [`segment-markdown.test.ts`](pantoken/docs/scripts/segment-markdown.test.ts).
